data.text: Animated items looked darker in GUI. The owner traced it to Shadow Drop 3.0.4, whose shadows draw over animated items. Mechanism: ImmediatelyFast batch_animated_item_updates sends animated items to its own AnimatedItemAtlas texture, while Shadow Drop (inject before GuiRenderState.forEachItem in prepareItemElements) blits shadows from the vanilla itemAtlas. Different textures likely get re-batched, putting the shadow above the item. Set immediatelyfast.json batch_animated_item_updates=false (backup immediatelyfast.json.bak); needs a restart; owner to verify.
